question: How should one understand the partless reality through differentiated aspects?
premises: In the earlier discussion, awareness of the partless arose through parts and subparts such as the qualities.
The same method applies in the present context.
Differentiated aspects can disclose an undivided reality.
inference: Therefore one should understand the partless reality here too through its differentiated aspects.
plain_english: Therefore, just as in the earlier discussion awareness of the partless reality arose through parts and subparts beginning with the qualities, so too it should be understood here.
